requirements.statement: JWT tokens are issued on login and validated on every protected route.
requirements.title: JWT authentication

requirements.statement: At least two roles exist and endpoints are restricted by role.
requirements.title: Role-based authorization

requirements.statement: A cache (Redis or similar) is configured and actually used by at least one read-heavy endpoint.
requirements.title: Caching layer

requirements.statement: Automated tests exist, run under a framework, and exercise core logic rather than only the application context.
requirements.title: Automated tests

requirements.statement: Consistent structure, no dead code, errors handled at boundaries.
requirements.title: Code quality

requirements.statement: Creativity and originality of the solution.
requirements.title: Creativity
requirements.unverifiableReason: Not locatable in code, report or deployment; this criterion stays with the evaluator.

sourceText:
CS402 Final Project — Web Application Security
1. Authentication with JWT — 15 marks
2. Role-based authorization (admin/user) — 15 marks
3. Caching layer for read-heavy endpoints — 10 marks
4. Automated tests with meaningful coverage — 20 marks
5. Code quality and creativity — 40 marks
